production_precondition_documented.note: Raw Post.body is not exposed by the public read-only API and Render/DB access is prohibited in this phase. The guarded cover_only command captures the live body SHA-256 and character count at dry-run/apply time and verifies byte-for-byte preservation (before==after), rolling back on any change. After the dry-run reveals the live SHA, the operator may pin it into precondition.sha256/chars for a hard pre-write check.
